rubrics.justification: Reasonable overall identification of an expanded blastocyst with visible ICM, but the grading is somewhat optimistic and includes features not clearly supported by the image, especially a well-defined TE and confidently thinned zona.
Thoroughly integrates age, tubal factor diagnosis, ovarian response, sperm parameters, endometrium, lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo prognosis.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible prognosis estimate, though some assumptions (euploidy rate, trilaminar endometrium, cumulative success) are stronger than the provided data support.

Recommendations are largely consistent with standard IVF practice, especially single embryo transfer in a good-prognosis young patient, though suggestions like exercise restriction and ERA are somewhat more speculative or conditional.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer management and contingency planning, but some advice remains generic and a few items are not tightly tailored to the limited available data.
